parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster to query.
> Call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldName
parameters.description:
The container field. Valid values:

- **clusterId**: cluster ID
- **image**: image name
- **imageId**: image ID
- **namespace**: namespace.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldValue
parameters.description: The value of the container field.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The group ID of the server to query.
> Call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to obtain the group ID of the server.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.

parameters.name: RiskName
parameters.description: The name of the baseline check risk item.

parameters.name: RiskStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the baseline check. Valid values:
- **1**: failed 
- **3**: passed.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the check item. Valid values:
- **1**: failed
- **2**: verifying 
- **3**: passed 
- **5**: expired 
- **6**: ignored.

parameters.name: StrategyId
parameters.description: The ID of the baseline check policy.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The query type. Valid values:
- **uuid**: asset ID.

parameters.name: TypeName
parameters.description:
The level-1 type of the baseline.
> Call the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description:
The UUID of the asset.
> Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
